label: a newer head never skips, so a fixed sendback opens a rework lane
a stale sendback breaks the pass, so the next live rework waits a pulse
old:
echo "rework $slug: head ${head:0:8} is newer than the sendback, archived to $arch (no rework lane)"
      continue
new:
echo "rework $slug: head ${head:0:8} is newer than the sendback, archived to $arch (no rework lane)"
      break

label: an unreadable head is treated as stale, so a git outage archives a real rework
the archive copies instead of moving, so the sendback is claimed on the next pass
